## Experience

- AI Automation Engineer (Jan 2026 – Jul 2026): production AI-agent workflows for B2B SaaS customers, orchestrating data, search, CRM and outreach tools.
- Senior Integration & Solution Engineer (Oct 2021 – Jul 2026): 500+ apps across discovery and delivery, 300+ shipped and maintained live. REST, GraphQL, webhooks, polling, scheduled triggers, OAuth 2.0, JWT and Basic Auth.

## Platforms

Zapier, n8n, Make, Integry, Squig, GoHighLevel. CRMs include Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics 365, Pipedrive, Zoho CRM, Close, Keap, Apollo, Clay and Gong; accounting includes Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks.

## Case studies

- [Signup enrichment agent](https://umar8092.github.io/projects/signup/): Turns every new signup into a full lead brief inside the customer's CRM.
- [Multi-source research agent](https://umar8092.github.io/projects/research/): Builds a full company profile, pain points and decision-makers before sales reaches out.
- [Net-new lead discovery agent](https://umar8092.github.io/projects/discovery/): Finds new prospects and checks their websites for buying signals, replacing manual prospecting.
- [Enrichment-to-outreach agent](https://umar8092.github.io/projects/outreach/): Sources, qualifies and writes to leads, then loads them straight into email sequences.
- [Multi-directional accounting sync](https://umar8092.github.io/projects/accounting/): Keeps contacts, invoices, taxes and items identical across MYOB, Xero, QuickBooks and a SaaS product.
- [Email template export](https://umar8092.github.io/projects/templates/): Lets users of an email-design product send their templates straight to their email provider.
- [Lead ads to webinar registration](https://umar8092.github.io/projects/webinar/): Registers LinkedIn and Meta lead-form submissions as Livestorm webinar attendees in real time.
- [Microsoft, Google and Meta app verification](https://umar8092.github.io/projects/approvals/): Hands-on with each platform's developer side, taking connectors through verification and review.
- [Daily shipped-work digest](https://umar8092.github.io/projects/digest/): Posts a daily Slack summary of every GitHub and Bitbucket commit from the last 24 hours.
- [Live catalog sync](https://umar8092.github.io/projects/catalog/): Keeps the company's Webflow website catalog matched to its MySQL database, every day.
